title: 第十三章 无药可医第十四章 神迹
lines: 雪梅是从天牢里用圣天子手令将程章氏给捞了出来。
如果她再过去晚点。
这位极其倒霉的灾民大概率会被天牢的狱卒给随便找个理由弄死。
作为一位奄奄一息的灾民，还是当今天子失德的罪证，如果不是天子授意，那么她和她的儿子就和路边的杂草一样，随便被哪里刮的一阵风吹一下就永远倒下去了。
甚至都不用风去吹。
草民这种东西，在封建时代，可能走着走着自己就倒下去，再也起不来了。
都是范阳那块地出来。
虽然看上去冷若冰霜，但雪梅没有被冰冷的皇宫给磨得失去人性，在将程章氏和她儿子提出天牢后，她没有急着带着他们去面圣。
而是去差小宫女点了几位上了年纪的健妇，然后是抬着这两人，再随手从太医馆拉了一个太医，一起去坤宁宫面圣。
从这点来看。
雪梅其实是一位十分体贴的秘书。
领导安排了任务，总不能让他们死在半路上吧？
说句难听的，就算是要死，也要吊着一口气，等见了圣天子再死。
也亏得圣天子左墟今天大发神威。
不然只是一司乐的雪梅，靠着天子的私玺带口谕想这么顺利的办成这些事，实在是有些不太现实。
等雪梅带着一干人面圣的时候。
已是黄昏。
残阳如血，夕阳的余辉落在坤宁宫的琉璃金瓦上镀上了一层血色，这里的血腥味依然刺鼻，四周隐约有蝇蚊汇聚而来的趋势，但这些恼人的小东西只是靠近此处，就莫名其妙的身子僵硬蜷缩落地。
似乎这片土地在排斥抗拒着蚊蝇。
作为昭明帝实际上宠幸标记的女人。
雪梅面圣倒不用太麻烦。
她先是一个人进去，在冬暖阁面见了和一群丘八没规矩坐一块的圣天子，得到他的允许后才是按照礼仪恭敬退出，带着一个赎罪军军士去外面领人进来。
在退出冬暖阁的时候。
雪梅偷偷瞄了一眼状若泼妇，披头散发被铁链拴在寝殿角落的柳皇后。
柳皇后也瞧见了她，瞧见了这冷清大宫女的超常待遇。
不知为何忽然暴怒的柳皇后试图起身，但马上被一柄花扇重重砸在右下肋！她当即和一条上岸缺氧的大鱼一样倒在地上翻白眼张嘴挣扎！
无辜微笑的花蝶摇动花扇。
雪梅见状微微点头。
‘自作孽，不可活。’
皇后的位置，怕是用不了几个月就要空出来了……
封建时代。
一个草芥如果能面圣，那就是走了天大的运道，看在皇帝老子的面子上，地方父母官都会照顾一二。
不然前脚刚刚面圣，后脚你就非自然死亡了，那打的是谁的脸呢？
程章氏是抱着她的儿子连滚带爬进的冬暖阁。
倒不是这可怜的草芥被身边身形彪悍的赎罪军给拳打脚踢了，而是她单纯的腿软。
这寡妇这辈子就没见过这么大，这么亮，这么气派的地。
她可怜的知识让她面对夜晚灯火辉煌的坤宁宫手足无措。
content_en:
Xuemei used the Shengtianzi's warrant to fish out the Cheng Zhang family from the prison.
If she goes there later.
There is a high probability that this extremely unlucky victim will be killed by the jailer in the sky prison for any reason.
As a dying disaster victim, it is also evidence of the emperor's immorality. If it were not for the emperor's instructions, then she and her son would be like weeds on the roadside, falling down forever if blown by a gust of wind.
It doesn't even have to be blown by the wind.
In the feudal era, people like ordinary people might fall down by themselves while walking and never get up again.
They all come from Fan Yang's land.
Although she looked as cold as ice, Xuemei was not dehumanized by the cold palace. After taking Cheng Zhang and her son out of the prison, she did not rush to take them to face the saint.
Instead, he sent a young palace maid to order a few elderly and healthy women, then carried these two people, and then casually pulled an imperial doctor from the imperial medical hall, and went to Kunning Palace to meet the saint together.
From this point of view.
Xuemei is actually a very considerate secretary.
The leader has arranged a task, so we can't let them die on the way, right?
To put it bluntly, even if you are going to die, you have to hold your breath and wait until you see the Holy Emperor before you die.
Thanks to the great power of the Holy Emperor Zuoxu today.
Otherwise, it would be unrealistic for Xuemei, who is just a music player, to rely on the emperor's private seal and oral instructions to accomplish these things so smoothly.
When Xuemei brought a group of people to face the Saint.
It's dusk.
The setting sun is like blood, and the afterglow of the setting sun coats the glazed gold tiles of Kunning Palace with a layer of blood. The smell of blood here is still pungent. There is a vague tendency of flies and mosquitoes gathering around, but these annoying little things just get close to this place, and their bodies become inexplicably stiff and curled up.
It seems that this land is repelling mosquitoes and flies.
As a woman who is actually the mark of Emperor Zhaoming's favor.
Xuemei’s face to face doesn’t need to be too troublesome.
She first went in alone and met with the Holy Emperor who was sitting with a group of Qiu Babuo in Dongnuan Pavilion. After getting his permission, she respectfully withdrew according to etiquette and took a sergeant of the Atonement Army outside to usher people in.
When exiting Dongnuang Pavilion.
Xuemei secretly glanced at Queen Liu, who looked like a shrew, with disheveled hair and was chained in the corner of the dormitory.
Queen Liu also saw her and saw the extraordinary treatment of this deserted palace maid.
Queen Liu, who was suddenly furious for some reason, tried to get up, but was immediately hit hard by a flower fan on her lower right ribs! She immediately fell to the ground, rolled her eyes, opened her mouth and struggled like a big fish that came ashore and was starved of oxygen!
The innocent smiling butterfly shakes the flower fan.
Xuemei nodded slightly when she saw this.
‘You will not live if you do your own evil. ’
The queen's position will probably be vacant within a few months...
Feudal era.
If a poor person can meet the Holy Spirit, he has great luck. For the sake of the emperor, the local parents and officials will take care of him.
Otherwise, as soon as you face the saint with your front foot, you will die unnaturally with your back foot. Then whose face will you hit?
Mrs. Cheng Zhang climbed into the Dongnuang Pavilion with her son in her arms.
It wasn't that the poor Cao Jie was beaten and kicked by the sturdy Atonement Army around her, but that her legs were simply weak.
The widow had never seen such a big, bright, and majestic place in her life.
Her poor knowledge left her at a loss when facing the brightly lit Kunning Palace at night.
